shared_elements: upright monolithic slab/pillar bearing carved figural imagery
animals rendered in profile with prominent heads
repeated row of similar heads/faces across a band
low-relief carving with figures against a plain ground
justification: Both are upright carved pillars organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a band of repeated similar heads near the top of each and animal/creature forms in relief, which is the strongest correspondence. But the specific content differs sharply: A shows sparse, highly schematic isolated animals (quadrupeds, birds, a long-necked creature) and abstract lines on an otherwise empty ground, while B shows dense, wholly filled interlocking foliate/masklike ornament with human-like faces embedded in scrollwork, leaving no blank field.
